title: Vama Wovenfab IPO Details
intro:
Vama Wovenfab IPO is a book build issue of ₹49.54 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 14.53 lakh shares of ₹49.54 crore.

Vama Wovenfab IPO opens for subscription on Sep 15, 2026 and closes on Sep 17, 2026. The allotment for the Vama Wovenfab IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 18, 2026. Vama Wovenfab IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 22, 2026.

Vama Wovenfab IPO is set issue price band at ₹324 to ₹341 per share. The lot size for an application is 400 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,72,800 (800 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (1,200 shares), amounting to ₹4,09,200.

Gretex Corporate Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Nikunj Stock Brokers Ltd.

Refer to Vama Wovenfab IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in March 2011, Vama Wovenfab Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of PP and HDPE woven sack bags and fabric-based packaging products. The Company also trades in plastic granules and provides customised bulk packaging solutions to B2B customers across industries such as agriculture, food processing, chemicals, fertilizers, sugar and cement.

The Company's product portfolio includes PP/HDPE woven bags and fabrics, BOPP bags, HDPE trampoline sheets, coloured woven fabric sheets and loop handle bags in different sizes, weights and colours as per customer requirements. Its manufacturing process involves melting and extruding plastic granules into tapes, weaving them into fabric and converting the fabric into customised finished bags. The Company also uses recycled granules and various additives and ancillary materials to enhance product quality and performance.

The Company operates its manufacturing facility in Nani Daman, Daman, where production of PP/HDPE woven sack bags and fabrics commenced in 2013. The facility is supported by skilled manpower, in-house quality control systems and stable power supply.
The Company has established long-term relationships with customers and focuses on customised solutions, timely delivery, product quality and continuous process improvement.
As of April 30, 2026, the Company had 94 employees, including 85 employees in operations.
strengths: Focus on product and process improvement.

faqs.question: How to apply in Vama Wovenfab IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Vama Wovenfab IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Vama Wovenfab IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Vama Wovenfab IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Vama Wovenfab IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: You can apply in Vama Wovenfab IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account.
